item.title: The BEST SONG to Introduce Someone to KORN, According to JONATHAN DAVIS
item.description: So you want to introduce someone to Korn. Good luck. You’ve got nearly three decades’ worth of dreadlocks, detuned guitars, and unresolved childhood trauma to work with.

item.title: The Day KORN Knocked a Guy Out Mid-Show… and Then WROTE A SONG About It
item.description: Not every song is born in a studio with clean instruments and sober minds. Some, like Korn’s Clown, crawl out of drug-fueled all-nighters in dingy apartments, shaped as much by the chaos around them as by the riffs themselves.

item.title: The Surprise You Missed in Korn’s 1997 Track "A.D.I.D.A.S."
item.description: Ever really listened to the breakdown in Korn’s 1997 track “A.D.I.D.A.S.”? And I mean actually listened—ears glued to every sound, every tiny layer. There’s a surprise in there you probably missed.

item.title: KORN's Debut Album Turns 30: Jonathan Davis Reflects on the Band's Legacy
item.description: Friday, October 11, marked 30 years since KORN unleashed their self-titled debut album (listen below). To commemorate the occasion, Jonathan Davis popped up on social media to share the album cover along with a few nostalgic words: “I can’t believe you’re 30 years old.

item.title: Korn’s Creative Process: Ray Luzier Breaks Down the Band’s Approach
item.description: Korn’s drummer, Ray Luzier, has been pounding the skins for the band since 2007, and he’s got plenty of stories to tell. In a chat with Modern Drummer, Luzier reflected on some of the band’s most memorable moments, from their biggest hits to their more out-there experiments.
